newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada grain stocks as of March 31.
newsitem.headline: Canada grain stocks as of March 31.

text.p: Statistics Canada survey of farm and commercial grain stocks on March 31 in millions of tonnes, with farm stocks and total of a year earlier:
'97 FARM STOCKS COMMERCIAL TOTAL '96 FARM '96 TOTAL
'97 FARM STOCKS COMMERCIAL TOTAL '96 FARM '96 TOTAL
Statistics Canada said farm stocks of wheat and feed grains were considerably higher on March 31 than they were at the same time a year ago. Stocks of canola were lower.

The federal agency said that last year at this time, low levels of world wheat and feed grains raised international wheat prices to levels that enticed producers in Canada to devote more land to these crops. The increased harvests of wheat and barley in the fall of 1996 were responsible for the larger stocks this March.
StatsCan said that as farmers switched more land into wheat and barley, canola acreage decreased, resulting in lower production followed by reduced stocks in March.

Total stocks, including stocks in commercial positions, were one percent above the five-year average, StatsCan said. Marketing problems in the September-to-March period delayed an expected jump in exports for the crop year.
